model: Editorial research order with separate legal-role and substantial-authority screens. No additive score, legal confidence percentage, or automatic legal conclusion.

categories.label: Internal Revenue Code
categories.precedential_scope: Governing statutory text; interpreted by courts
categories.required_checks: Scope, amendment history, effective date and exceptions

categories.label: Highest federal court interpretation
categories.precedential_scope: National judicial precedent on the issue decided
categories.required_checks: Holding, applicable law, facts and subsequent developments

categories.label: Federal appellate interpretation
categories.precedential_scope: Potentially controlling in the relevant review route
categories.required_checks: Circuit, published status, review venue and later history

categories.label: Final Treasury regulation
categories.precedential_scope: Effective regulation, subject to valid authority and judicial review
categories.required_checks: Applicability, validity, amendments and statutory consistency

categories.label: Temporary Treasury regulation
categories.precedential_scope: Effective temporary rule within its authorized period

categories.label: Tax Court division opinion
categories.precedential_scope: Citable judicial authority; contextual precedent analysis
categories.required_checks: Issue, holding, appellate route and later history

categories.label: Tax Court memorandum opinion
categories.precedential_scope: Citable judicial authority; often factual application
categories.required_checks: Material factual fit and later treatment

categories.label: Published revenue ruling
categories.precedential_scope: Published administrative precedent, not a regulation
categories.required_checks: Factual fit, subsequent rulings and judicial developments

categories.label: Published revenue procedure
categories.precedential_scope: Published procedure subject to its conditions
categories.required_checks: Eligibility, required elections, dates and supersession

categories.label: Proposed Treasury regulation
categories.precedential_scope: Proposal; do not present as final law
categories.required_checks: Any express reliance provision and later finalization

categories.label: Private letter ruling
categories.required_checks: Recipient, facts, revocation and applicable penalty-use rule

categories.label: Technical advice memorandum
categories.required_checks: Subject taxpayer, issue, later developments and permitted uses

categories.label: Chief counsel advice
categories.precedential_scope: Nonprecedential written advice under the general rule
categories.required_checks: Underlying primary authorities; no automatic substantial-authority inclusion

categories.label: Tax Court small-case summary opinion
categories.required_checks: Confirm small tax case status; no appeal under section 7463

categories.label: Internal Revenue Manual
categories.precedential_scope: Staff process guidance; not substantive law
categories.required_checks: Exact subsection, revision, interim guidance and statutory basis

categories.label: General agency publication or webpage
categories.precedential_scope: General explanation; not binding legal authority
categories.required_checks: Find and cite the underlying authority and relevant date

categories.label: Agency frequently asked question
categories.precedential_scope: Nonprecedential; qualifying fact-sheet FAQs have a distinct penalty-authority use
categories.required_checks: Verify the Fact Sheet, linked news release, effective facts, version, and reasonable reliance
